notes: D1 oracle is docs/london-se-national-rail-d1/oracle-clash-report.md only. No product lib/cities/london-se-national-rail/ exists yet. Not generated from GTFS. No stopIds in this file.

ARCHITECTURE: Option A (Tim's decision) — eight potential per-terminus station groups, seven built (Waterloo, Victoria, London Bridge, Liverpool Street, King's Cross, St Pancras International, Paddington). Euston is NOT built — the report never names Euston's in-scope regional operator (only Caledonian Sleeper, which is excluded). No single hub-lock exists for this region; do not attempt to collapse these groups into one board or one CityConfig hub.

doNotGroup is required WITHIN two groups: London Bridge (Southeastern / Southern / Thameslink, three operators) and Liverpool Street (Greater Anglia / c2c, two operators). See stationGroups[].doNotGroup below and hazard-pack.md H4.

CRS codes below are carried from the oracle report's 'examples' list (report line 256) and are NOT verified against a live GTFS dump or Darwin response — the report itself flags this (line 103). Confirm before wiring the adapter.

No 'lines' array is provided for any group — no printed route/line map to transcribe, same as every National Rail-only region packed so far. Each group is a flat destination+operator departure list; see direction-model-memo.md.
City lands as 'Coming Soon' (status stays planned; there is no separate coming-soon enum value in registry.js) until National Rail is unblocked, same as every other UK National Rail region.

License: OGL 2.0 baseline with NRE amendments for Darwin. Confidence 'unclear' on third-party rider redistribution — same open item as every other UK National Rail region. National Rail static GTFS (Transitland) is CC-BY-2.0 UK, confidence 'clear', reference-only.

No docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md (or docs/uk-ledger.md) exists yet. docs/country-lane.md names the UK ledger retrofit as required before the next NR region after East Midlands/North East/West of England/South Wales/Rest of Scotland/Rest of Wales/West Yorkshire — this IS that next region and the retrofit has not run. This pack proceeds on the oracle report alone per the dispatch instruction; boundary facts here (GWR/Paddington, SWR/Waterloo, CrossCountry, LNER-excluded) should be folded into a future docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md rather than rediscovered by the next region. Flagged, not resolved, here.

stationGroups.name: London Waterloo
stationGroups.class: SWR terminus (southwest, Solent corridor). Single operator, no internal doNotGroup.
stationGroups.boundaryNote: SWR continues southwest past this catalog's edge (West of England / Solent region, not yet built). Through-running only, not a merge point — flag for D2 ledger, not resolved here.

stationGroups.name: London Victoria
stationGroups.class: Southern/Gatwick Express hub (south coast, Gatwick Airport). Same agency family (Greater Thameslink Railway) — one board, distinguished by destination+operator, not a doNotGroup case.

stationGroups.name: London Bridge
stationGroups.doNotGroupReason: Three operators at one physical station, separate platform logic per report line 48/136/231. Three separate boarding sections required; do not merge into one flat departure list.
stationGroups.class: Southeastern/Southern/Thameslink hub (southeast, south coast, cross-London). Most central terminus per report, but explicitly not treated as a single-hub-lock for the whole region (Option A rejects that — see hazard-pack.md H1).

stationGroups.name: Liverpool Street
stationGroups.doNotGroupReason: Two operators at one physical station, separate platform logic per report line 49/137/232.

stationGroups.name: London King's Cross
stationGroups.class: Great Northern hub (north via East Coast Main Line, regional). LNER also calls here but is EXCLUDED from this catalog — board-eligibility verdict undecided/excluded, see coverageGaps.

excludedOperators.reason: Report's own board-eligibility table marks LNER undecided pending operator confirmation on unreserved-carriage walk-up policy (report lines 128-129, 156). This pack's own research attempt (curl fetches of lner.co.uk, LNER Wikipedia, Google, DuckDuckGo) could not obtain verifiable operator-policy text — every source was either client-rendered JS with no server text, or an anti-bot challenge page. Excluded per the dispatch instruction: keep undecided, exclude rather than guess.

stationGroups.proposedDoNotGroup: Against St Pancras International's Thameslink group below-ground — same complex, different physical buildings and operators. Proposed, not built as a merge (they are already two separate stationGroups entries here, which is the doNotGroup outcome in practice).

stationGroups.name: St Pancras International
stationGroups.class: Thameslink (St Pancras Thameslink, below-ground). Eurostar also calls here (above-ground) but is EXCLUDED — out-checkin, compulsory pre-departure check-in (report line 124/159).

excludedOperators.reason: Compulsory 45-minute pre-departure check-in at Eurostar Channel Terminal, airport-style border/security/luggage screening. International service, out of v1 scope by design (report line 124).

stationGroups.name: London Paddington
stationGroups.class: GWR hub (southwest via Great Western Main Line, Wales). Night Riviera Sleeper also calls here but is EXCLUDED — out-reservation.

excludedOperators.reason: Compulsory reservation for sleeping cars; seated-accommodation walk-up status unverified (report line 126/158, skip risk noted but not resolved by this pack).

stationGroups.boundaryNote: GWR continues west past this catalog's edge (West of England region, already built — docs/west-of-england-d1/, Bristol Temple Meads hub). Through-running only, not a merge point — flag for D2 ledger, not resolved here.

notBuilt.name: London Euston
notBuilt.reason: Report names 'regional services' and Caledonian Sleeper at Euston (C2/C3 point 5) but never names the regional operator — not in the report's TOC scope list (lines 9, 31, 38). Caledonian Sleeper itself is excluded (out-reservation). No named in-scope TOC means no station group can be built here without inventing an operator the report doesn't confirm. See hazard-pack.md H4/H6 and jim-handoff.md.

Report marks these 'TBD...may be out-of-scope D1' (report line 53/101). Farringdon and Blackfriars appear again as Thameslink calling points in the board-eligibility table (report line 147), which is suggestive but not a decision this pack makes on the report's behalf. Flagged as an open item, not resolved.

coverageGaps: National Rail real-time: OpenLDBWS documented and technically live, but BLOCKED at the account level (AU-registered RDM account; Tim re-registering with UK address). Not a feed problem. Do not wire DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN until it exists.

National Rail licensing: OGL 2.0 baseline permits redistribution with attribution, but the RDM Platform Agreement's language on downstream redistribution to third-party rider clients is UNCLEAR in public sources. OPEN ITEM FOR TIM ONLY — do not resolve here.

LNER board-eligibility verdict remains UNDECIDED. This pack attempted to resolve it (see stationGroups[kings-cross].excludedOperators and jim-handoff.md) and could not obtain verifiable operator-policy text with the tools available. LNER is excluded from the catalog pending a real operator confirmation, not defaulted to in.
Euston is not built — no named in-scope regional TOC in the oracle report. See notBuilt above.

Seven secondary termini (Blackfriars, Cannon Street, Charing Cross, Farringdon, Fenchurch Street, Marylebone, Moorgate) are not built — report marks them TBD/possibly out-of-scope. See notBuilt above.

CRS codes for all seven built groups are UNVERIFIED against a live GTFS dump or Darwin response — the oracle report itself flags this (lines 103, 256). Confirm before adapter wiring; crsVerified: false on every stationGroups entry.

Regional-boundary through-running (GWR at Paddington, SWR at Waterloo, CrossCountry system-wide) is NOT de-duplicated against West of England or any other region in this pack — flagged for a future D2/country-ledger pass, not resolved here.
